"""Pure independent eligibility theorem and unchanged legacy/economic fixtures."""
from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS, ModuleType
import ast
import importlib.util
import json
import sys

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
checks, refusals = [], []


def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


original = load('previous55', HERE.parent / 'ex055-raw-recovery-oracle/analysis_reference_recovery.py')
new = load('recovery_analysis', HERE / 'analysis_reference.py')
common = ModuleType('common')
common.SOURCE_CALLS = []
sys.modules['common'] = common
oracle = load('recovery_oracle', HERE / 'boundary_recovery_oracle.py')


def check(name, condition):
    assert condition, name
    checks.append(name)


def refuse(name, fn):
    try:
        fn()
    except (AssertionError, ValueError, KeyError):
        refusals.append(name)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(name)


# Reuse only the standalone synthetic fake-ledger constructor, no predecessor
# test execution or writes. This constructor has no real market/account calls.
old_fixture_source = (HERE.parent / 'ex054-raw-body-oracle/analysis_focused.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
fixture_ast = next(node for node in ast.parse(old_fixture_source).body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'fixture')
fixture_namespace = {'NS': NS, 'deepcopy': deepcopy, 'np': np, 'pd': pd, 'original': original}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[fixture_ast], type_ignores=[]), '<retained independent synthetic fixture>', 'exec'), fixture_namespace)
fixture = fixture_namespace['fixture']

before = ast.parse((HERE.parent / 'ex055-raw-recovery-oracle/analysis_reference_recovery.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
after = ast.parse((HERE / 'analysis_reference.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))


class RemoveRecoveryAddition(ast.NodeTransformer):
    condition_count = 0
    function_count = 0

    def visit_FunctionDef(self, node):
        if node.name == '_audit_boundary_recovery_eligibility':
            self.function_count += 1
            return None
        return self.generic_visit(node)

    def visit_If(self, node):
        if isinstance(node.test, ast.Compare) and any(isinstance(item, ast.Constant)
            and item.value == 'RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY' for item in node.test.comparators):
            self.condition_count += 1
            return None
        return self.generic_visit(node)


remove = RemoveRecoveryAddition()
restored = remove.visit(deepcopy(after))
check('only explicit theorem and two new-enum integration branches', remove.condition_count == 2 and remove.function_count == 1)
check('entire legacy module AST exact after new enum theorem removed', ast.dump(before, include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(restored, include_attributes=False))
old53 = ast.parse((HERE.parent / 'ex055-raw-recovery-oracle/analysis_reference_original53.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for name in ['annual', 'paired']:
    old_fn = next(node for node in old53.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == name)
    new_fn = next(node for node in after.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == name)
    check('original53 economic AST exact ' + name, ast.dump(old_fn, include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(new_fn, include_attributes=False))

for mechanism in ['RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_CLOSE', 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY',
                  'MEAN_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_CLOSE', 'MEAN_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY']:
    args = fixture(mechanism)
    old_row, old_frame = original.summarize(*args)
    new_row, new_frame = new.summarize(*args)
    check('legacy full economic and diagnostic summary exact ' + mechanism, old_row == new_row)
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old_frame, new_frame, check_exact=True)
    checks.append('legacy returned frame exact ' + mechanism)

for mechanism in ['MEAN_BEAR_TIME_ABOVE_CLOSE', 'MEAN_BEAR_TIME_ABOVE_BODY']:
    args = fixture(mechanism)
    frame = args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions
    frame['last_exit_category'] = frame.last_exit_category.replace({'BELOW': 'ABOVE', 'ABOVE': 'BELOW'})
    old_row, old_frame = original.summarize(*args)
    new_row, new_frame = new.summarize(*args)
    check('legacy ABOVE full summary exact ' + mechanism, old_row == new_row)
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old_frame, new_frame, check_exact=True)
    checks.append('legacy ABOVE frame exact ' + mechanism)


def recovery_fixture():
    args = fixture('RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY')
    bound, result, config, ledger = args
    dates = result.runs[0].execution.decisions.signal_date
    n = len(dates)
    p = {'bull': {'entry': .6, 'exit': .95, 'acf_min': None, 'momentum_min': None,
                  'max_hold': 1, 'stop_loss': None, 'trailing_stop': None},
         'bear': {'entry': .6, 'exit': .95, 'acf_min': .1, 'momentum_min': None,
                  'max_hold': 1, 'stop_loss': None, 'trailing_stop': None},
         'confirmation': {'scope': 'both', 'enabled': True, 'profile': 'all',
                          'orientation': 1, 'threshold': -.2}, 'exit_on_regime_change': True,
         'regime_threshold': 0., 'mechanism': 'RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY'}
    ff = pd.DataFrame({'close': 100., 'regime': 'bear', 'bull_range_position': .8,
        'bear_range_position': .8, 'acf1': 0., 'momentum20': -.1, 'confirmation_score': 0.,
        'entry_direction_up': False, 'entry_signal_close': 100., 'entry_signal_open': 101.,
        'previous_signal_close': 100., 'previous_regime': 'bear',
        'regime_momentum': -.1, 'previous_regime_momentum': -.1}, index=np.arange(n))
    cases = [
        (100., 101., 'bear', .2, .2, 0.),  # originalpass/bodydown still entry
        (99., 100., 'bear', .2, .2, 0.),   # bear TIME BELOW
        (98., 97., 'bear', .2, 0., -.4),   # actual recovery, score rejects
        (97., 98., 'bull', .2, .2, -.4), # boundary BODY/score refusal, price reason precedes
        (96., 95., 'bear', .8, 0., 0.),   # original range fails, no exception
        (98., 97., 'bear', .2, 0., 0.),   # recovery entry consumes context
        (99., 98., 'bear', .2, 0., 0.),   # holding failed ACF no exception, TIME ABOVE
        (98., 97., 'bear', .2, 0., 0.),   # ABOVE cannot restore eligibility
        (100., 101., 'bear', .2, .2, 0.), # originalpass/bodydown still entry
        (98., 97., 'bear', .99, 0., 0.),  # held RANGE overrides TIME
        (99., 98., 'bear', .2, 0., 0.),   # range context cannot restore eligibility
    ]
    for i, (close, opening, regime, position, acf, score) in enumerate(cases):
        ff.loc[i, ['close', 'regime', 'bull_range_position', 'bear_range_position', 'acf1',
                   'confirmation_score', 'entry_direction_up', 'entry_signal_close', 'entry_signal_open']] = [
            close, regime, position, position, acf, score, close > opening, close, opening]
    ff['previous_regime'] = ff.regime.shift(1, fill_value='bear')
    ff['regime_momentum'] = np.where(ff.regime.eq('bull'), .1, -.1)
    ff['previous_regime_momentum'] = np.where(ff.previous_regime.eq('bull'), .1, -.1)
    frame = oracle._state_path(ff, p)
    frame['signal_date'] = dates.to_numpy()
    result.runs[0].execution.decisions = frame
    config['payload']['parameters'] = p
    return bound, result, config, ledger


args = recovery_fixture()
row, frame = new.summarize(*args)
check('new complete synthetic summary passes', row['gate_counts']['acf_recovery_opportunities'] == 2)
check('original ACFpass bodydown entries retained', frame.signal_reason.iloc[0] == 'entry' and frame.signal_reason.iloc[8] == 'entry')
check('failed ACF recovery remains score-rejected', frame.entry_acf_recovery_applies.iloc[2] and frame.signal_reason.iloc[2] == 'confirmation_rejected')
check('successful recovery consumes context', frame.signal_reason.iloc[5] == 'entry' and frame.last_exit_category.iloc[6] is None)
check('holding ACF fail cannot be exception', not frame.entry_eligible.iloc[6] and not frame.entry_acf_recovery_applies.iloc[6])
check('exact20 price reason before failed score preserves opportunity', frame.entry_direction_gate_applies.iloc[3] and frame.confirmation_opportunity.iloc[3] and frame.signal_reason.iloc[3] == 'entry_direction_rejected' and not frame.confirmation_pass.iloc[3])
check('price rejection keeps BELOW memory', frame.last_exit_category.iloc[4] == 'BELOW')
check('old original-failing ACF remains recorded', not frame.entry_acf_pass.iloc[2] and frame.entry_acf_value.iloc[2] == 0.)
for key in ['entry_acf_recovery_applies', 'entry_eligible', 'confirmation_opportunity',
            'entry_acf_pass', 'entry_acf_value', 'entry_direction_gate_applies', 'entry_direction_up']:
    args = recovery_fixture()
    fake = args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions
    fake.loc[2, key] = not fake.loc[2, key] if fake[key].dtype == bool else .123
    refuse('counterfeit recovery theorem ' + key, lambda args=args: new.summarize(*args))
for key, value in [('last_exit_category', 'EQUAL'), ('last_exit_category', 'COUNTERFEIT'),
                   ('last_exit_reason', 'range'), ('last_exit_route', 'bull'),
                   ('signal_reason', 'entry'), ('signal_reason', 'entry_direction_rejected'),
                   ('confirmation_pass', True), ('acf1', np.nan)]:
    args = recovery_fixture()
    args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions.loc[2, key] = value
    refuse('counterfeit new eligibility metadata ' + str((key, value)), lambda args=args: new.summarize(*args))
args = recovery_fixture()
args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions.loc[5, 'entry_signal_open'] = args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions.loc[5, 'entry_signal_close']
refuse('BODY equality cannot restore eligibility', lambda: new.summarize(*args))
args = recovery_fixture()
args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions.loc[6, 'entry_acf_recovery_applies'] = True
refuse('holding counterfeit exception refused', lambda: new.summarize(*args))

# Eligibility exception carries no score dependence; score gating still applies.
args = recovery_fixture()
args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions.loc[2, 'confirmation_score'] = -.49
same = new._audit_boundary_recovery_eligibility(args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions, args[2])
check('recovery predicate score-independent', same['acf_recovery_opportunities'] == 2)
for size in [1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 11, 1636]:
    args = recovery_fixture()
    partial = args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions.iloc[:size]
    got = new._audit_boundary_recovery_eligibility(partial, args[2])
    check('held route/recovery causal prefix ' + str(size), got['acf_recovery_opportunities'] == int(partial.entry_acf_recovery_applies.sum()))

# ADDITIONAL_ANALYSIS_CHECKS

# Old55 full summary is unchanged, using its own retained independent pure
# state recurrence and original fake-ledger constructor. No accounts are read.
old55_oracle = load('old55_oracle', HERE.parent / 'ex055-raw-recovery-oracle/raw_recovery_oracle.py')
old55_tests = ast.parse((HERE.parent / 'ex055-raw-recovery-oracle/analysis_focused.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
old55_constructor = next(node for node in old55_tests.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'recovery_fixture')
old55_namespace = {'fixture': fixture, 'oracle': old55_oracle, 'np': np, 'pd': pd}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[old55_constructor], type_ignores=[]), '<old55 standalone synthetic constructor>', 'exec'), old55_namespace)
args = old55_namespace['recovery_fixture']()
old_row, old_frame = original.summarize(*args)
new_row, new_frame = new.summarize(*args)
check('old55 entire summary and cash-path diagnostics exact', old_row == new_row)
pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old_frame, new_frame, check_exact=True)
checks.append('old55 returned native-synthetic frame exact')

# Historical EX020 identity retains its original all-row raw boundary theorem.
args = fixture('NEW_BULL_BODY_UP')
df = args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions
df['regime'] = 'bear'
df['previous_regime'] = 'bull'
df.loc[df.index[:10], 'regime'] = 'bull'
df.loc[df.index[:10], 'previous_regime'] = 'bear'
df['entry_direction_gate_applies'] = df.regime.eq('bull') & df.previous_regime.eq('bear')
df['signal_reason'] = np.where(~df.confirmation_opportunity, 'flat',
    np.where(df.entry_direction_gate_applies & ~df.entry_direction_up, 'entry_direction_rejected',
             np.where(df.confirmation_pass, 'entry', 'confirmation_rejected')))
old_row, old_frame = original.summarize(*args)
new_row, new_frame = new.summarize(*args)
check('old20 NEW_BULL_BODY_UP entire summary exact', old_row == new_row)
pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old_frame, new_frame, check_exact=True)
checks.append('old20 synthetic returned frame exact')
check('legacy20 all-row ineligible boundary retained', df.entry_direction_gate_applies.iloc[7] and not df.confirmation_opportunity.iloc[7])


def refresh(args):
    bound, result, config, ledger = args
    features = result.runs[0].execution.decisions.copy()
    features['entry_direction_up'] = features.entry_signal_close.gt(features.entry_signal_open)
    fresh = oracle._state_path(features, config['payload']['parameters'])
    result.runs[0].execution.decisions = fresh
    return args


args = recovery_fixture()
df = args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions
df.loc[2, 'confirmation_score'] = -.1
args = refresh(args)
row, df = new.summarize(*args)
check('no residual neutral support floor: negative score original theta entry', df.entry_acf_recovery_applies.iloc[2] and df.signal_reason.iloc[2] == 'entry')
check('support field not added to58 helper or state', 'entry_recovery_support_pass' not in df)

args = recovery_fixture()
args[2]['payload']['parameters']['confirmation']['threshold'] = .2
df = args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions
df.loc[[0, 1, 3, 5], 'confirmation_score'] = .3
df.loc[2, 'confirmation_score'] = .1
args = refresh(args)
row, df = new.summarize(*args)
check('positive original theta can reject enhanced eligibility', df.entry_acf_recovery_applies.iloc[2] and df.signal_reason.iloc[2] == 'confirmation_rejected')
check('price boundary applies before passing positive theta', df.confirmation_pass.iloc[3] and df.signal_reason.iloc[3] == 'entry_direction_rejected')
check('score and boundary refusal retain context', df.last_exit_category.iloc[4] == 'BELOW' and df.last_exit_category.iloc[5] == 'BELOW')

for score, wanted in [(-.20000000000000004, 'confirmation_rejected'), (-.2, 'entry'), (-.19999999999999998, 'entry')]:
    args = recovery_fixture()
    args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions.loc[2, 'confirmation_score'] = score
    args = refresh(args)
    row, df = new.summarize(*args)
    check('exact original score threshold no epsilon ' + repr(score), df.signal_reason.iloc[2] == wanted)

for opening in [97., 96., 98.]:
    args = recovery_fixture()
    args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions.loc[3, 'entry_signal_open'] = opening
    args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions.loc[3, 'confirmation_score'] = 0.
    args = refresh(args)
    row, df = new.summarize(*args)
    check('boundary strict body equality rejects ' + str(opening), df.signal_reason.iloc[3] == ('entry' if opening < 97. else 'entry_direction_rejected'))

# Raw-bull boundary is global diagnostic even on a held row. Held exit rules
# remain untouched, so that row cannot be classified as price refusal.
args = recovery_fixture()
df = args[1].runs[0].execution.decisions
df.loc[1, ['regime', 'regime_momentum']] = ['bull', .1]
df['previous_regime'] = df.regime.shift(1, fill_value='bear')

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def annual(account):
    dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(account.date)).normalize()
    equity=account.equity.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    assert len(equity)==1636 and dates[0]==pd.Timestamp('2020-01-02') and dates[-1]==pd.Timestamp('2026-09-30')
    rows={}
    anchor=1_000_000.
    for year in sorted(set(dates.year)):
        segment=equity[dates.year==year]
        wealth=np.r_[anchor,segment]
        rows[str(year)]={'return':float(segment[-1]/anchor-1),
            'drawdown':float(np.max(1-wealth/np.maximum.accumulate(wealth))),
            'opening_equity':anchor,'closing_equity':float(segment[-1])}
        anchor=float(segment[-1])
    return rows

def _audit_recovery_eligibility(frame, config):
    """Independently derive original/extended eligibility from actual before-state.

    The exception contains no confirmation-score predicate. This is signal
    eligibility authentication, not a forecast or account-profit calculation.
    """
    p = config['payload']['parameters']
    assert config['mechanism'] == 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY'
    assert p['confirmation']['scope'] == 'both' and p['confirmation']['enabled'] is True
    assert p['confirmation']['profile'] == 'all' and p['confirmation']['orientation'] == 1
    assert np.isfinite(frame.acf1.to_numpy()).all(), 'Recovery cannot waive missing raw ACF'
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(frame.entry_acf_value.to_numpy(), frame.acf1.to_numpy())
    assert frame.target_position.isin((0., 1.)).all()
    before_flat = frame.target_position.shift(1, fill_value=0.).eq(0.)
    held_route = frame.regime.where(frame.signal_reason.eq('entry')).shift(1).ffill()
    assert held_route[~before_flat].isin(('bull', 'bear')).all(), 'Held route must follow prior signal entry'
    routes = frame.regime.where(before_flat, held_route)
    assert routes.isin(('bull', 'bear')).all()
    acf_pass = np.array([p[route]['acf_min'] is None or value >= p[route]['acf_min']
                         for route, value in zip(routes, frame.acf1, strict=True)], dtype=bool)
    range_pass = frame.range_position.to_numpy() <= np.array([p[route]['entry'] for route in routes])
    momentum_pass = np.array([p[route]['momentum_min'] is None or value >= p[route]['momentum_min']
                             for route, value in zip(routes, frame.momentum20, strict=True)], dtype=bool)
    body_up = frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.entry_signal_open)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(body_up.to_numpy(), frame.entry_direction_up.to_numpy())
    category = frame.last_exit_category
    assert (category.isna() | category.isin(('BELOW', 'EQUAL', 'ABOVE'))).all()
    recovery = (before_flat & frame.regime.eq('bear') & frame.last_exit_reason.eq('time')
                & frame.last_exit_route.eq('bear') & category.eq('BELOW') & body_up
                & ~acf_pass & range_pass & momentum_pass)
    eligible = range_pass & momentum_pass & (acf_pass | recovery.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(acf_pass, frame.entry_acf_pass.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(recovery.to_numpy(), frame.entry_acf_recovery_applies.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(eligible, frame.entry_eligible.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal((before_flat & eligible).to_numpy(), frame.confirmation_opportunity.to_numpy())
    assert not frame.entry_direction_gate_applies.any(), 'Recovery has no direction veto'
    assert not frame.signal_reason.eq('entry_direction_rejected').any()
    return {'acf_recovery_opportunities': int(recovery.sum()),
            'original_eligible_flat_opportunities': int((before_flat & range_pass & momentum_pass & acf_pass).sum()),
            'enhanced_eligible_flat_opportunities': int((before_flat & eligible).sum()),
            'holding_eligibility_has_no_exception': True}


def _audit_boundary_recovery_eligibility(frame, config):
    """Independently derive original/extended eligibility from actual before-state.

    The exception contains no confirmation-score predicate. This is signal
    eligibility authentication, not a forecast or account-profit calculation.
    """
    p = config['payload']['parameters']
    assert config['mechanism'] == 'RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY'
    assert p['mechanism'] == config['mechanism']
    for name in ('entry_direction_up', 'entry_direction_gate_applies', 'entry_acf_pass',
                 'entry_acf_recovery_applies', 'entry_eligible', 'confirmation_opportunity', 'confirmation_pass'):
        assert frame[name].dtype == np.dtype(bool), 'Required native boolean dtype: ' + name
    assert p['confirmation']['scope'] == 'both' and p['confirmation']['enabled'] is True
    assert p['confirmation']['profile'] == 'all' and p['confirmation']['orientation'] == 1
    assert np.isfinite(frame.acf1.to_numpy()).all(), 'Recovery cannot waive missing raw ACF'
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(frame.entry_acf_value.to_numpy(), frame.acf1.to_numpy())
    assert frame.target_position.isin((0., 1.)).all()
    before_flat = frame.target_position.shift(1, fill_value=0.).eq(0.)
    held_route = frame.regime.where(frame.signal_reason.eq('entry')).shift(1).ffill()
    assert held_route[~before_flat].isin(('bull', 'bear')).all(), 'Held route must follow prior signal entry'
    routes = frame.regime.where(before_flat, held_route)
    assert routes.isin(('bull', 'bear')).all()
    acf_pass = np.array([p[route]['acf_min'] is None or value >= p[route]['acf_min']
                         for route, value in zip(routes, frame.acf1, strict=True)], dtype=bool)
    range_pass = frame.range_position.to_numpy() <= np.array([p[route]['entry'] for route in routes])
    momentum_pass = np.array([p[route]['momentum_min'] is None or value >= p[route]['momentum_min']
                             for route, value in zip(routes, frame.momentum20, strict=True)], dtype=bool)
    body_up = frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.entry_signal_open)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(body_up.to_numpy(), frame.entry_direction_up.to_numpy())
    category = frame.last_exit_category
    assert (category.isna() | category.isin(('BELOW', 'EQUAL', 'ABOVE'))).all()
    recovery = (before_flat & frame.regime.eq('bear') & frame.last_exit_reason.eq('time')
                & frame.last_exit_route.eq('bear') & category.eq('BELOW') & body_up
                & ~acf_pass & range_pass & momentum_pass)
    eligible = range_pass & momentum_pass & (acf_pass | recovery.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(acf_pass, frame.entry_acf_pass.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(recovery.to_numpy(), frame.entry_acf_recovery_applies.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(eligible, frame.entry_eligible.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal((before_flat & eligible).to_numpy(), frame.confirmation_opportunity.to_numpy())
    previous_momentum = frame.previous_regime_momentum.to_numpy()
    momentum = frame.regime_momentum.to_numpy()
    assert np.isfinite(previous_momentum).all() and np.isfinite(momentum).all()
    previous_regime = np.where(previous_momentum >= p['regime_threshold'], 'bull', 'bear')
    raw_regime = np.where(momentum >= p['regime_threshold'], 'bull', 'bear')
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(previous_regime, frame.previous_regime.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(raw_regime, frame.regime.to_numpy())
    boundary = frame.regime.eq('bull') & frame.previous_regime.eq('bear')
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(boundary.to_numpy(), frame.entry_direction_gate_applies.to_numpy())
    return {'acf_recovery_opportunities': int(recovery.sum()),
            'original_eligible_flat_opportunities': int((before_flat & range_pass & momentum_pass & acf_pass).sum()),
            'enhanced_eligible_flat_opportunities': int((before_flat & eligible).sum()),
            'holding_eligibility_has_no_exception': True,
            'direction_boundary_signal_days': int(boundary.sum()),
            'direction_gate_opportunities': int((before_flat & eligible & boundary).sum())}


def summarize(bound,result,config,ledger):
    run=result.runs[0]
    own,bh=run.execution.account_daily,run.buyhold.account_daily
    pd.testing.assert_series_equal(pd.to_datetime(own.date),pd.to_datetime(bh.date))
    years,benchmark_years=annual(own),annual(bh)
    cagr=float((own.equity.iloc[-1]/1_000_000)**(252/1636)-1)
    bcagr=float((bh.equity.iloc[-1]/1_000_000)**(252/1636)-1)
    assert abs(cagr-run.observation.net_cagr)<1e-12
    closed=int(run.execution.trades.status.eq('CLOSED').sum())
    negative=[y for y in years if benchmark_years[y]['return']<0]
    gates={'return':cagr>=1.5*bcagr if bcagr>0 else cagr>0,
           'annual_drawdown':all(years[y]['drawdown']<benchmark_years[y]['drawdown'] for y in years),
           'frequency':closed*60/1636>=4,
           'negative_buyhold_year_profit':all(years[y]['return']>0 for y in negative)}
    paths=ledger.inspect_run(run)
    audit=ledger.verify_account(bound,result)
    benchmark_paths=ledger.annual_account(run.buyhold.execution)[0]
    assert len(paths['cycles'])==len(run.execution.trades)
    for row in paths['annual_account']:
        assert abs(row['account_return']-years[str(row['year'])]['return'])<1e-12
    for row in benchmark_paths:
        assert abs(row['account_return']-benchmark_years[str(row['year'])]['return'])<1e-12
    frame=run.execution.decisions.copy()
    if config['mode']=='M0':
        masks=None
    else:
        opportunity=frame.confirmation_opportunity.astype(bool)
        if config['mode']=='M1':
            expected=frame.confirmation_score.ge(config['payload']['parameters']['confirmation']['threshold'])
        else:
            direction=1 if config['mode']=='M2' else -1
            expected=(direction*frame.confirmation_delta).ge(0)
        assert np.array_equal(expected,frame.confirmation_pass)
        state_confirmed=pd.Series(True,index=frame.index)
        if config.get('mechanism') == 'RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY':
            _audit_boundary_recovery_eligibility(frame, config)
            state_confirmed=~frame.entry_direction_gate_applies | frame.entry_direction_up
        if config.get('mechanism') == 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY':
            _audit_recovery_eligibility(frame, config)
        if config.get('mechanism') in ('MEAN_BEAR_TIME_REENTRY_CLOSE','MEAN_BEAR_TIME_REENTRY_BODY'):
            independent=(frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.previous_signal_close) if config['mechanism'].endswith('CLOSE')
                         else frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.entry_signal_open))
            assert np.array_equal(independent,frame.entry_direction_up)
            applies=opportunity & frame.regime.eq('bear') & frame.last_exit_reason.eq('time') & frame.last_exit_route.eq('bear')
            assert np.array_equal(applies,frame.entry_direction_gate_applies)
            state_confirmed=~applies | independent
        if config.get('mechanism') in ('MEAN_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_CLOSE', 'MEAN_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY',
                                     'MEAN_BEAR_TIME_ABOVE_CLOSE', 'MEAN_BEAR_TIME_ABOVE_BODY',
                                     'MEAN_FIXED120_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_CLOSE', 'MEAN_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_SEGMENT_CLOSE', 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_CLOSE', 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY'):
            independent=(frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.previous_signal_close) if config['mechanism'].endswith('CLOSE')
                         else frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.entry_signal_open))
            assert np.array_equal(independent,frame.entry_direction_up)
            category=frame.last_exit_category
            assert (category.isna() | category.isin(('BELOW','EQUAL','ABOVE'))).all(), 'Invalid exit category'
            selected='BELOW' if '_BELOW_' in config['mechanism'] else 'ABOVE'
            applies=(opportunity & frame.regime.eq('bear') & frame.last_exit_reason.eq('time')
                     & frame.last_exit_route.eq('bear') & category.eq(selected))
            assert np.array_equal(applies,frame.entry_direction_gate_applies)
            state_confirmed=~applies | independent
        if config.get('mechanism') in ('NEW_BULL_CLOSE_UP','NEW_BULL_BODY_UP','NEW_BULL_BODY_ANCHOR_LOSS','NEW_BULL_BODY_ANCHOR_LOSS2','MEAN_ACF_NEW_BULL_CLOSE','MEAN_ACF_NEW_BULL_BODY','BEAR_MEAN_ACF_BODY_ADVERSE_TR','BEAR_MEAN_ACF_BODY_ADVERSE_TR2','BEAR_MEAN_ACF_BODY_ADVERSE_TR3'):
            independent=(frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.previous_signal_close) if config['mechanism'] in ('NEW_BULL_CLOSE_UP','MEAN_ACF_NEW_BULL_CLOSE')
                         else frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.entry_signal_open))
            assert np.array_equal(independent,frame.entry_direction_up)
            applies=frame.regime.eq('bull') & frame.previous_regime.eq('bear')
            assert np.array_equal(applies,frame.entry_direction_gate_applies)
            state_confirmed=~applies | independent
        state_rejected=opportunity & ~state_confirmed
        score_rejected=opportunity & state_confirmed & ~expected
        assert np.array_equal(opportunity & state_confirmed & expected,frame.signal_reason.eq('entry'))
        assert np.array_equal(score_rejected,frame.signal_reason.eq('confirmation_rejected'))
        assert np.array_equal(state_rejected,frame.signal_reason.eq('entry_direction_rejected'))
        masks={'base_opportunities':int(opportunity.sum()),
            'rejected_opportunities':int(score_rejected.sum()),
            'state_rejected_opportunities':int(state_rejected.sum()),
            'raw_score_below_threshold_opportunities':int((opportunity & ~expected).sum()),
            'zero_delta_opportunities':int((opportunity & frame.confirmation_delta.eq(0)).sum())
                 if config['mode'] in ('M2','M3') else None,
            'groups':frame.assign(year=pd.to_datetime(frame.signal_date).dt.year,
                                 opportunity=opportunity.astype(int),rejected=score_rejected.astype(int),
                                 state_rejected=state_rejected.astype(int))
                .groupby(['year','regime'])[['opportunity','rejected','state_rejected']].sum().reset_index().to_dict('records')}
    if config.get('mechanism') == 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY':
        masks.update(_audit_recovery_eligibility(frame, config))
    if config.get('mechanism') == 'RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY':
        masks.update(_audit_boundary_recovery_eligibility(frame, config))
    actual_buys=run.execution.fills.side.eq('BUY')
    full_wealth=np.r_[1_000_000.,own.equity.to_numpy()]
    drawdown=float(np.max(1-full_wealth/np.maximum.accumulate(full_wealth)))
    row={key:config[key] for key in ('index','background','mode','candidate_id','content_sha256','existing_identity')}
    row.update(net_cagr=cagr,drawdown=drawdown,closed_trades=closed,frequency60=closed*60/1636,
        annual=years,benchmark_cagr=bcagr,benchmark_annual=benchmark_years,
        negative_benchmark_years=negative,gates=gates,qualified=all(gates.values()),
        total_fees=float(run.execution.fills.fees.sum()),
        signal_entries=int(frame.signal_reason.eq('entry').sum()),buy_fills=int(actual_buys.sum()),
        final_quantity=int(own.quantity.iloc[-1]),gate_counts=masks,paths=paths,account_audit=audit,
        request_hash=result.request_hash,result_hash=result.result_hash,
        raw_input_bindings={key:value.to_dict() for key,value in bound.input_bindings.items()},
        order_statuses={str(k):int(v) for k,v in run.execution.orders.status.value_counts().items()})
    return row,frame

def paired(first,second,label):
    # Difference is full policy outcome, not a sum of rejected predecessor trades.
    result={'comparison':label,'first':first['background']+'/'+first['mode'],
        'second':second['background']+'/'+second['mode'],
        'cagr_difference':second['net_cagr']-first['net_cagr'],
        'drawdown_difference':second['drawdown']-first['drawdown'],
        'closed_trade_difference':second['closed_trades']-first['closed_trades'],
        'annual_differences':{}}
    a={str(x['year']):x for x in first['paths']['annual_account']}
    b={str(x['year']):x for x in second['paths']['annual_account']}
    for year in a:
        result['annual_differences'][year]={'net_return':b[year]['account_return']-a[year]['account_return'],
            'price_contribution':b[year]['price_contribution']-a[year]['price_contribution'],
            'fee_contribution':b[year]['fee_contribution']-a[year]['fee_contribution']}
    def key(cycle):
        return (cycle['entry_fill_time'],cycle.get('exit_fill_time'),cycle['entry_route'])
    old={key(c):c for c in first['paths']['cycles']}
    new={key(c):c for c in second['paths']['cycles']}
    removed=[c for k,c in old.items() if k not in new]
    added=[c for k,c in new.items() if k not in old]
    result['cycle_changes']={'same_entry_exit_route':len(set(old)&set(new)),
        'removed_or_retimed':removed,'added_or_retimed':added,
        'warning':'different paths inherit different cash; old-cycle pnl is descriptive, not additive policy contribution'}
    return result

"""Independent raw-ACF signal-price-classified bear TIME-reentry oracle with bound dates.

Only signal predicates and the complete signal state are audited. Counts are
descriptive; this module never prepares/evaluates an account or predicts profit.
"""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from dataflows import canonical_frame_sha256
from common import SOURCE_CALLS


MECHANISMS = frozenset(('RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY',))


def _exit_category(close, anchor):
    """Strict price comparison at the final bear TIME signal; not trade PnL."""
    assert np.isfinite(close) and np.isfinite(anchor) and close > 0 and anchor > 0
    return 'BELOW' if close < anchor else 'ABOVE' if close > anchor else 'EQUAL'


def _warmup_sessions(p):
    """Exact original adaptive/confirmation warmup plus EX020 previous raw regime."""
    parent = max(p['bull']['range_window'], p['bear']['range_window'],
                 p['regime_window'] + 1, 21, p['confirmation']['lookback'] + 20)
    return max(parent, p['regime_window'] + 2)


def _reconstruct(bars, dates, p):
    """Recompute formulas and state without importing any strategy functions."""
    _validate_parameters(p)
    assert bars.index.is_unique and bars.index.is_monotonic_increasing
    assert dates.is_unique and dates.is_monotonic_increasing and dates.isin(bars.index).all()
    mechanism = p['mechanism']
    assert mechanism in MECHANISMS
    assert p['context'] == {'entry_gate': 'all', 'volume_basis': 'ADJUSTED',
                            'weighting': 'EQUAL_BLOCKS'}
    c = p['confirmation']
    assert c['enabled'] is True and c['profile'] == 'all'
    assert c['scope'] == 'both' and c['orientation'] == 1
    assert all(p[route]['cooldown'] == 0 for route in ('bull', 'bear'))
    assert type(c['lookback']) is int and 40 <= c['lookback'] <= 120
    assert np.isfinite(c['threshold'])
    close, opening, amount, volume = (bars[name].astype(float)
                                      for name in ('Close', 'Open', 'Amount', 'Volume'))
    for name in ('Close', 'Open', 'High', 'Low', 'Amount', 'Volume'):
        assert np.isfinite(bars[name]).all() and (bars[name] > 0).all(), name

    def covariance(items):
        centered = items - items.mean()
        variance = np.mean(centered ** 2)
        return np.nan if np.isclose(variance, 0) else float(
            np.dot(centered[1:], centered[:-1]) / 19 / variance)

    def rank(items):
        return float((np.count_nonzero(items < items[-1])
                      + .5 * np.count_nonzero(items == items[-1])) / len(items) - .5)

    full_acf = close.pct_change(fill_method=None).rolling(20).apply(covariance, raw=True)
    raw = pd.DataFrame({'acf': full_acf, 'turnover': amount / amount.rolling(20).mean(),
                        'volume': np.log(volume).diff().rolling(20).mean()}, index=bars.index)
    normalized = raw.apply(lambda series: series.rolling(c['lookback'],
        min_periods=c['lookback']).apply(rank, raw=True)).reindex(dates)
    assert np.isfinite(normalized.to_numpy()).all(), 'Incomplete causal score warmup'
    score = .5 * normalized.acf + .25 * normalized.turnover + .25 * normalized.volume
    raw_acf = full_acf.reindex(dates)
    positions = {route: ((close - bars.Low.rolling(p[route]['range_window']).min()) /
        (bars.High.rolling(p[route]['range_window']).max()
         - bars.Low.rolling(p[route]['range_window']).min())).reindex(dates)
        for route in ('bull', 'bear')}
    momentum20 = (close / close.shift(20) - 1).reindex(dates)
    full_momentum = close / close.shift(p['regime_window']) - 1
    momentum = full_momentum.reindex(dates)
    previous_momentum = full_momentum.shift(1).reindex(dates)
    signal_close, signal_open, previous_close = close.reindex(dates), opening.reindex(dates), close.shift(1).reindex(dates)
    for series in (raw_acf, *positions.values(), momentum20, momentum, previous_momentum,
                   signal_close, signal_open, previous_close):
        assert np.isfinite(series).all(), 'Incomplete causal input history'
    regimes = np.where(momentum >= p['regime_threshold'], 'bull', 'bear')
    previous_regimes = np.where(previous_momentum >= p['regime_threshold'], 'bull', 'bear')
    direction = (signal_close > signal_open).to_numpy()
    expected = pd.DataFrame({'acf1': raw_acf, 'close': signal_close, 'momentum20': momentum20,
        'regime_momentum': momentum, 'regime': regimes,
        'previous_regime_momentum': previous_momentum, 'previous_regime': previous_regimes,
        'bull_range_position': positions['bull'], 'bear_range_position': positions['bear'],
        'confirmation_score': score, 'confirmation_acf': normalized.acf,
        'confirmation_turnover': normalized.turnover, 'confirmation_volume': normalized.volume,
        'bear_acf_raw': raw_acf,
        'entry_signal_close': signal_close, 'entry_signal_open': signal_open,
        'previous_signal_close': previous_close, 'entry_direction_up': direction}, index=dates)
    return _state_path(expected, p)


def _state_path(features, p):
    """Independent state recurrence; features are causal and do not seed state."""
    expected = features.copy()
    assert np.isfinite(expected.acf1.to_numpy()).all(), 'Required original raw ACF must be finite even for recovery'
    for name in ('close', 'momentum20', 'confirmation_score', 'bull_range_position', 'bear_range_position'):
        assert np.isfinite(expected[name].to_numpy()).all(), 'Required finite state feature: ' + name
    assert expected.regime.isin(('bull', 'bear')).all()
    assert expected.previous_regime.isin(('bull', 'bear')).all()
    assert expected.entry_direction_up.dtype == np.dtype(bool)
    c = p['confirmation']
    holding, active, age, anchor, peak, last, last_route, category = False, None, 0, 0., 0., None, None, None
    records = []
    for i in range(len(expected)):
        route = active if holding else str(expected.regime.iloc[i])
        rp, position = p[route], expected[f'{route}_range_position'].iloc[i]
        entry_acf = expected.acf1.iloc[i]
        acf_pass = rp['acf_min'] is None or entry_acf >= rp['acf_min']
        range_pass = bool(position <= rp['entry'])
        momentum_pass = bool(rp['momentum_min'] is None or expected.momentum20.iloc[i] >= rp['momentum_min'])
        recovery = bool(not holding and not acf_pass and range_pass and momentum_pass
                        and expected.regime.iloc[i] == 'bear' and last == 'time'
                        and last_route == 'bear' and category == 'BELOW'
                        and expected.entry_direction_up.iloc[i])
        eligible = bool(range_pass and momentum_pass and (acf_pass or recovery))
        opportunity = bool(not holding and eligible)
        passed = bool(expected.confirmation_score.iloc[i] >= c['threshold'])
        gate = bool(expected.regime.iloc[i] == 'bull' and expected.previous_regime.iloc[i] == 'bear')
        record = {'holding_before': holding, 'route_before': active,
            'age_before': age if holding else 0, 'active_route': route, 'eligible': eligible,
            'range_position': float(position), 'entry_acf_value': float(entry_acf),
            'entry_acf_pass': bool(acf_pass), 'entry_acf_recovery_applies': recovery,
            'entry_eligible': eligible, 'confirmation_opportunity': opportunity,
            'confirmation_pass': passed, 'confirmation_exit_context': last or 'initial',
            'entry_direction_gate_applies': gate, 'last_exit_reason': last, 'last_exit_route': last_route,
            'last_exit_category': category}
        reason = 'flat'
        if holding:
            age += 1
            peak = max(peak, expected.close.iloc[i])
            loss = rp['stop_loss'] is not None and expected.close.iloc[i] / anchor - 1 <= -rp['stop_loss']
            trail = rp['trailing_stop'] is not None and expected.close.iloc[i] / peak - 1 <= -rp['trailing_stop']
            reason = ('loss' if loss else 'trailing' if trail else 'range' if position >= rp['exit']
                else 'time' if age >= rp['max_hold'] else 'regime'
                if p['exit_on_regime_change'] and expected.regime.iloc[i] != active else 'hold')
            if reason != 'hold':
                category = (_exit_category(expected.close.iloc[i], anchor)
                            if reason == 'time' and active == 'bear' else None)
                holding, active, last, last_route = False, None, reason, active
        elif eligible:
            reason = ('entry_direction_rejected' if gate and not expected.entry_direction_up.iloc[i]
                      else 'entry' if passed else 'confirmation_rejected')
            if reason == 'entry':
                holding, active, age = True, str(expected.regime.iloc[i]), 0
                anchor = peak = expected.close.iloc[i]
                last = last_route = category = None
        record.update(signal_reason=reason, target_position=float(holding))
        records.append(record)
    states = pd.DataFrame(records, index=expected.index)
    for name in ('route_before', 'last_exit_reason', 'last_exit_route', 'last_exit_category'):
        states[name] = pd.Series([record[name] for record in records], index=expected.index, dtype=object)
    for name in states:
        expected[name] = states[name]
    return expected


def _validate_parameters(p):
    """Respect original units/domains without casting any numeric parameter."""
    assert set(p) == {'bull', 'bear', 'regime_window', 'regime_threshold',
                      'exit_on_regime_change', 'confirmation', 'context', 'mechanism'}
    assert p['mechanism'] in MECHANISMS
    assert type(p['regime_window']) is int and 5 <= p['regime_window'] <= 60
    assert type(p['regime_threshold']) is float and -.2 <= p['regime_threshold'] <= .2
    assert type(p['exit_on_regime_change']) is bool
    c = p['confirmation']
    assert set(c) == {'enabled', 'profile', 'scope', 'orientation', 'lookback', 'threshold'}
    assert type(c['lookback']) is int and 40 <= c['lookback'] <= 120
    assert type(c['threshold']) is float and -.5 <= c['threshold'] <= .5
    assert c['enabled'] is True and c['profile'] == 'all' and c['scope'] == 'both'
    assert type(c['orientation']) is int and c['orientation'] == 1
    assert p['context'] == {'entry_gate': 'all', 'volume_basis': 'ADJUSTED', 'weighting': 'EQUAL_BLOCKS'}
    for route in ('bull', 'bear'):
        r = p[route]
        assert set(r) == {'range_window', 'entry', 'exit', 'max_hold', 'acf_min',
                          'stop_loss', 'trailing_stop', 'cooldown', 'momentum_min', 'limit_premium'}
        assert type(r['range_window']) is int and 21 <= r['range_window'] <= 360
        assert type(r['entry']) is float and type(r['exit']) is float
        assert 0 <= r['entry'] < r['exit'] <= 1
        assert type(r['max_hold']) is int and 1 <= r['max_hold'] <= 60
        assert type(r['cooldown']) is int and r['cooldown'] == 0
        for key in ('stop_loss', 'trailing_stop'):
            assert r[key] is None or 0 < r[key] < .5
        assert r['acf_min'] is None or (type(r['acf_min']) is float and -.6 <= r['acf_min'] <= .5)
        assert route != 'bear' or type(r['acf_min']) is float, 'Original bear ACF coordinate required'
        for key in ('acf_min', 'momentum_min'):
            assert r[key] is None or np.isfinite(r[key])
        assert 0 <= r['limit_premium'] < .09
    assert p['bull']['limit_premium'] == p['bear']['limit_premium']



def _audit_dates(ctx, bound, binding, frame, dates, bars):
    """Use the bound calendar/execute dates, never a T+1 signal price."""
    dates = dates.as_unit('ns')
    plan = binding.plan
    request = plan.requests[plan.calendar_name]
    calendar = ctx.data.fetch(request, prepared=binding.prepared)
    assert calendar.ready and not SOURCE_CALLS, 'Existing prepared calendar required; no fallback'
    assert calendar.identity.content_sha256 == plan.calendar_sha256, 'Bound calendar identity drift'
    assert canonical_frame_sha256(calendar.dataframe) == calendar.identity.content_sha256, 'Prepared calendar bytes drift'
    assert calendar.identity.dataset == str(request.dataset) and calendar.identity.symbol == request.symbol
    data = calendar.dataframe
    calendar_dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(data.Date)).normalize().as_unit('ns')
    assert calendar_dates.is_unique and calendar_dates.is_monotonic_increasing
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(calendar_dates, pd.date_range(request.start, request.end).as_unit('ns'), check_names=False)
    assert data.IsOpen.isin((0, 1)).all(), 'Invalid public calendar open flag'
    opened = calendar_dates[data.IsOpen.to_numpy() == 1]
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(opened, pd.DatetimeIndex(plan.calendar_dates).as_unit('ns'), check_names=False)
    previous = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(data.loc[data.IsOpen.eq(1), 'PreviousTradingDate'])).normalize().as_unit('ns')
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(previous[1:], opened[:-1], check_names=False)
    assert np.all(previous < opened), 'Public previous-session relation must be strict'
    window = plan.tradable_window
    expected_valid = opened[(opened >= pd.Timestamp(window.start)) & (opened <= pd.Timestamp(window.end))]
    locations = opened.get_indexer(expected_valid)
    assert len(expected_valid) and np.all(locations > 0), 'Complete pre-window signal calendar required'
    expected_signals = opened[locations - 1]
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(dates, expected_signals, check_names=False)
    actual_valid = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(frame.valid_session)).normalize().as_unit('ns')
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual_valid, expected_valid, check_names=False)
    assert dict(plan.signal_dates) == {valid.date(): signal.date()
        for valid, signal in zip(expected_valid, expected_signals, strict=True)}, 'Entire public signal mapping drift'
    # Execution preparation covers first T through final T+1, while the signal
    # OHLC request correctly stops at final T. Only dates below are inspected.
    execution_dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bound.execution_data.execution_daily.dt)).normalize().as_unit('ns')
    assert execution_dates.is_unique and execution_dates.is_monotonic_increasing
    execution_expected = expected_signals.union(expected_valid).sort_values()
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(execution_dates, execution_expected, check_names=False)
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(pd.DatetimeIndex(bound.execution_data.evaluation_sessions).normalize().as_unit('ns'),
                                  expected_valid, check_names=False)
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(bars.index.as_unit('ns').intersection(execution_dates), expected_signals, check_names=False)
    signal_locations = execution_dates.get_indexer(dates)
    assert np.all(signal_locations >= 0) and np.all(signal_locations + 1 < len(execution_dates))
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(execution_dates[signal_locations + 1], actual_valid, check_names=False)
    return {'source': 'Existing prepared bound calendar and execution_daily date sequence',
            'calendar_sha256': plan.calendar_sha256, 'exact_signal_execute_pairs': len(dates),
            'first_signal': dates[0].date().isoformat(), 'last_signal': dates[-1].date().isoformat(),
            'first_valid_session': actual_valid[0].date().isoformat(),
            'last_valid_session': actual_valid[-1].date().isoformat(),
            'final_signal_ohlc_date': bars.index[-1].date().isoformat(),
            'future_signal_prices_used': False, 'final_pair_retained': True}



def _assert_exit_metadata(actual, expected, name):
    """Compare only nullable signal metadata; all financial fields remain exact."""
    categories = {'last_exit_reason': {'time', 'regime', 'range', 'loss', 'trailing'},
                  'last_exit_route': {'bull', 'bear'},
                  'last_exit_category': {'BELOW', 'EQUAL', 'ABOVE'}}
    assert name in categories
    actual, expected = np.asarray(actual, dtype=object), np.asarray(expected, dtype=object)
    assert actual.shape == expected.shape
    missing = np.array([value is None for value in expected])
    for i, (value, wanted) in enumerate(zip(actual, expected, strict=True)):
        if missing[i]:
            assert value is None or isinstance(value, (float, np.floating)) and np.isnan(value), name
        else:
            assert isinstance(wanted, str) and wanted in categories[name], name
            assert isinstance(value, str) and value == wanted, (name, i, value, wanted)
    return int(missing.sum())


def audit_boundary_recovery(ctx, bound, frame, p):
    """Authenticate all features/state and predecision exit category from own signal-entry anchor."""
    assert p == bound.strategy.payload['parameters'], 'Audit the actual bound parameters'
    assert len(bound.input_bindings) == 1
    binding = next(iter(bound.input_bindings.values()))
    assert binding.prepared is not None, 'Prepared S013 input required'
    request = binding.plan.requests['daily']
    fetched = ctx.data.fetch(request, prepared=binding.prepared)
    assert fetched.ready and not SOURCE_CALLS, 'Existing prepared data must be ready; no preparation or fallback'
    assert canonical_frame_sha256(fetched.dataframe) == fetched.identity.content_sha256, 'Prepared daily bytes drift'
    assert fetched.identity.dataset == str(request.dataset) and fetched.identity.symbol == request.symbol, 'Prepared daily identity/request drift'
    assert request.symbol == '510500.SH', 'Only authorized S013 instrument'
    bars = fetched.dataframe.copy()
    bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
    assert bars.index.is_unique and bars.index.is_monotonic_increasing
    assert bars.index[0] >= pd.Timestamp(request.start) and bars.index[-1] <= pd.Timestamp(request.end)
    dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(frame.signal_date)).normalize()
    assert len(dates) and dates.is_unique and dates.is_monotonic_increasing
    assert dates.isin(bars.index).all()
    expected = _reconstruct(bars, dates, p)
    # State before the decision is internal oracle state, not strategy output.
    internal = {'holding_before', 'route_before', 'age_before', 'active_route', 'eligible'}
    audited = [name for name in expected if name not in internal]
    assert set(audited).issubset(frame.columns), 'Missing native audit fields'
    nullable_counts = {}
    for name in audited:
        if name in ('last_exit_reason', 'last_exit_route', 'last_exit_category'):
            nullable_counts[name] = _assert_exit_metadata(frame[name].to_numpy(), expected[name].to_numpy(), name)
        else:
            if expected[name].dtype == np.dtype(bool):
                assert frame[name].dtype == np.dtype(bool), 'Native boolean audit dtype: ' + name
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(frame[name].to_numpy(), expected[name].to_numpy(), err_msg=name)
    date_audit = _audit_dates(ctx, bound, binding, frame, dates, bars)
    assert bars.index[-1] == dates[-1], 'Daily prepared request must stop at last T signal'
    years = sorted(set(dates.year))
    groups = []
    for year in ['ALL', *years]:
        year_mask = np.ones(len(dates), bool) if year == 'ALL' else dates.year == year
        for route in ('bull', 'bear'):
            mask = year_mask & expected.regime.eq(route).to_numpy()
            opportunity = mask & expected.confirmation_opportunity.to_numpy(bool)
            passed = expected.confirmation_pass.to_numpy(bool)
            gate = expected.entry_direction_gate_applies.to_numpy(bool)
            direction = expected.entry_direction_up.to_numpy(bool)
            entry = expected.signal_reason.eq('entry').to_numpy()
            refused = expected.signal_reason.eq('entry_direction_rejected').to_numpy()
            score_refused = expected.signal_reason.eq('confirmation_rejected').to_numpy()
            assert np.array_equal(entry, expected.confirmation_opportunity.to_numpy(bool) & (~gate | direction) & passed)
            assert np.array_equal(refused, expected.confirmation_opportunity.to_numpy(bool) & gate & ~direction)
            assert np.array_equal(score_refused, expected.confirmation_opportunity.to_numpy(bool) & (~gate | direction) & ~passed)
            groups.append({'year': str(year), 'route': route, 'signal_days': int(mask.sum()),
                'original_eligible_flat_opportunities': int((opportunity & expected.entry_acf_pass.to_numpy(bool)).sum()),
                'enhanced_eligible_flat_opportunities': int(opportunity.sum()),
                'acf_recovery_opportunities': int((mask & expected.entry_acf_recovery_applies.to_numpy(bool)).sum()),
                'acf_recovery_entries': int((mask & expected.entry_acf_recovery_applies.to_numpy(bool) & entry).sum()),
                'acf_recovery_score_rejections': int((mask & expected.entry_acf_recovery_applies.to_numpy(bool) & ~passed).sum()),
                'score_pass_opportunities': int((opportunity & passed).sum()),
                'direction_boundary_signal_days': int((mask & gate).sum()),
                'direction_gate_opportunities': int((opportunity & gate).sum()),
                'direction_rejected_opportunities': int((mask & refused).sum()),
                'score_rejected_after_direction': int((mask & score_refused).sum()),
                'both_direction_and_score_reject': int((opportunity & gate & ~direction & ~passed).sum()),
                'signal_entries': int((mask & entry).sum()),
                'signal_reasons': {str(k): int(v) for k, v in expected.loc[mask, 'signal_reason'].value_counts().items()}})
    for key in ('signal_days', 'original_eligible_flat_opportunities', 'enhanced_eligible_flat_opportunities',
                'acf_recovery_opportunities', 'acf_recovery_entries', 'acf_recovery_score_rejections', 'signal_entries'):
        assert sum(row[key] for row in groups if row['year'] == 'ALL') == sum(
            row[key] for row in groups if row['year'] != 'ALL')
    return {'status': 'PASS', 'mechanism': p['mechanism'], 'signal_days': len(dates),
        'confirmation_threshold': float(p['confirmation']['threshold']), 'date_audit': date_audit,
        'warmup_sessions': _warmup_sessions(p),
        'prepared_data_authentication': {'daily_content_sha256': fetched.identity.content_sha256,
            'prepared_manifest_sha256': binding.prepared.manifest_sha256,
            'prepared_space_id': str(binding.prepared.space_id),
            'preparation_id': str(binding.prepared.preparation_id),
            'request': {'dataset': str(request.dataset), 'symbol': request.symbol,
                        'start': str(request.start), 'end': str(request.end)},
            'existing_prepared_fetch_only': True, 'canonical_daily_bytes_checked': True},
        'nullable_exit_metadata_absences': nullable_counts,
        'exit_category_counts': {key: int(expected.last_exit_category.eq(key).sum())
            for key in ('BELOW', 'EQUAL', 'ABOVE')},
        'audited_fields': audited + ['signal_date', 'valid_session'], 'groups': groups,
        'limits': 'Complete native signal path, retained predecision exit memory and strictly classified bear TIME price state, and all signal years; counts only. No changed cash replay, profit attribution, forecast or independent validation.'}

"""Synthetic only: independent causal formulas, state and date refusals."""
from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
from types import ModuleType, SimpleNamespace as NS
import importlib.util
import json
import sys

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
common = ModuleType('common')
common.SOURCE_CALLS = []
sys.modules['common'] = common
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('raw_oracle', ROOT / 'boundary_recovery_oracle.py')
oracle = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(oracle)
checks = []
refusals = []


def check(name, condition):
    assert condition, name
    checks.append(name)


def refuse(name, fn):
    try:
        fn()
    except (AssertionError, KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
        refusals.append(name)
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Expected refusal: ' + name)


def parameters():
    r = {'range_window': 21, 'entry': .6, 'exit': .95, 'max_hold': 1,
         'acf_min': .1, 'stop_loss': None, 'trailing_stop': None, 'cooldown': 0,
         'momentum_min': None, 'limit_premium': .01}
    return {'bull': deepcopy(r), 'bear': deepcopy(r), 'regime_window': 5,
            'regime_threshold': 0., 'exit_on_regime_change': True,
            'confirmation': {'enabled': True, 'profile': 'all', 'scope': 'both',
                             'orientation': 1, 'lookback': 40, 'threshold': -.2},
            'context': {'entry_gate': 'all', 'volume_basis': 'ADJUSTED', 'weighting': 'EQUAL_BLOCKS'},
            'mechanism': 'RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY'}


def features(close, regime=None, position=None, score=None, acf=None, opening=None):
    n = len(close)
    regime = ['bear'] * n if regime is None else regime
    previous = [close[0] + 1, *close[:-1]]
    opening = previous if opening is None else opening
    return pd.DataFrame({'close': close, 'regime': regime,
        'bull_range_position': [.2] * n if position is None else position,
        'bear_range_position': [.2] * n if position is None else position,
        'acf1': [.2] * n if acf is None else acf, 'momentum20': [-.1] * n,
        'confirmation_score': [0.] * n if score is None else score,
        'entry_direction_up': np.array(close) > np.array(opening),
        'previous_regime': ['bear', *regime[:-1]]},
        index=pd.bdate_range('2030-01-01', periods=n))


def path(close, **kwargs):
    return oracle._state_path(features(close, **kwargs), parameters())


# Formula-only synthetic OHLCV, at least 360 history rows for every numeric corner.
n = 510
t = np.arange(n)
cl = 100 * np.cumprod(1 + .003 * np.sin(t * .71) + .001 * np.cos(t * .23))
bars = pd.DataFrame({'Date': pd.bdate_range('2029-01-01', periods=n), 'Close': cl,
                     'Open': cl * (1 + .002 * np.sin(t * .43)), 'High': cl * 1.03, 'Low': cl * .97,
                     'Volume': 500 + 30 * np.sin(t * .19),
                     'Amount': 50000 + 3000 * np.cos(t * .17)})
bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(bars.Date).normalize()
dates = bars.index[380:]
p = parameters()
original = deepcopy(p)
out = oracle._reconstruct(bars, dates, p)
check('parameters not coerced or mutated', p == original)
check('raw ACF used identically', np.array_equal(out.acf1, out.bear_acf_raw))
check('no centered diagnostics', not any(k in out for k in ('bear_acf_centered', 'bear_acf_baseline')))
full_momentum = bars.Close / bars.Close.shift(p['regime_window']) - 1
check('previous raw momentum full daily shift before reindex', np.array_equal(out.previous_regime_momentum, full_momentum.shift(1).reindex(dates)))
check('all-row raw boundary diagnostic', np.array_equal(out.entry_direction_gate_applies, out.regime.eq('bull') & out.previous_regime.eq('bear')))
sparse_dates = dates[::3]
sparse = oracle._reconstruct(bars, sparse_dates, p)
check('previous raw uses actual daily not previous sparse signal', np.array_equal(sparse.previous_regime_momentum, full_momentum.shift(1).reindex(sparse_dates)))
returns = bars.Close.pct_change(fill_method=None)
for loc in [380, 400, 509]:
    values = returns.iloc[loc - 19:loc + 1].to_numpy()
    z = values - values.mean()
    expected = float(np.dot(z[1:], z[:-1]) / 19 / np.mean(z ** 2))
    check('raw mean20 covariance19 variance20 ' + str(loc), out.acf1.loc[bars.index[loc]] == expected)
check('BODY direction strict all rows', np.array_equal(out.entry_direction_up, bars.Close.gt(bars.Open).reindex(dates)))
for size in [1, 19, 80, len(dates)]:

import numpy as np

MECHANISMS = frozenset(('RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY',))


def _exit_category(close, anchor):
    """Strict price comparison at the final bear TIME signal; not trade PnL."""
    assert np.isfinite(close) and np.isfinite(anchor) and close > 0 and anchor > 0
    return 'BELOW' if close < anchor else 'ABOVE' if close > anchor else 'EQUAL'


def _warmup_sessions(p):
    """Exact original adaptive/confirmation warmup plus EX020 previous raw regime."""
    parent = max(p['bull']['range_window'], p['bear']['range_window'],
                 p['regime_window'] + 1, 21, p['confirmation']['lookback'] + 20)
    return max(parent, p['regime_window'] + 2)


def _reconstruct(bars, dates, p):
    """Recompute formulas and state without importing any strategy functions."""
    _validate_parameters(p)
    assert bars.index.is_unique and bars.index.is_monotonic_increasing
    assert dates.is_unique and dates.is_monotonic_increasing and dates.isin(bars.index).all()
    mechanism = p['mechanism']
    assert mechanism in MECHANISMS
    assert p['context'] == {'entry_gate': 'all', 'volume_basis': 'ADJUSTED',
                            'weighting': 'EQUAL_BLOCKS'}
    c = p['confirmation']
    assert c['enabled'] is True and c['profile'] == 'all'
    assert c['scope'] == 'both' and c['orientation'] == 1
    assert all(p[route]['cooldown'] == 0 for route in ('bull', 'bear'))
    assert type(c['lookback']) is int and 40 <= c['lookback'] <= 120
    assert np.isfinite(c['threshold'])
    close, opening, amount, volume = (bars[name].astype(float)
                                      for name in ('Close', 'Open', 'Amount', 'Volume'))
    for name in ('Close', 'Open', 'High', 'Low', 'Amount', 'Volume'):
        assert np.isfinite(bars[name]).all() and (bars[name] > 0).all(), name

    def covariance(items):
        centered = items - items.mean()
        variance = np.mean(centered ** 2)
        return np.nan if np.isclose(variance, 0) else float(
            np.dot(centered[1:], centered[:-1]) / 19 / variance)

    def rank(items):
        return float((np.count_nonzero(items < items[-1])
                      + .5 * np.count_nonzero(items == items[-1])) / len(items) - .5)

    full_acf = close.pct_change(fill_method=None).rolling(20).apply(covariance, raw=True)
    raw = pd.DataFrame({'acf': full_acf, 'turnover': amount / amount.rolling(20).mean(),
                        'volume': np.log(volume).diff().rolling(20).mean()}, index=bars.index)
    normalized = raw.apply(lambda series: series.rolling(c['lookback'],
        min_periods=c['lookback']).apply(rank, raw=True)).reindex(dates)
    assert np.isfinite(normalized.to_numpy()).all(), 'Incomplete causal score warmup'
    score = .5 * normalized.acf + .25 * normalized.turnover + .25 * normalized.volume
    raw_acf = full_acf.reindex(dates)
    positions = {route: ((close - bars.Low.rolling(p[route]['range_window']).min()) /
        (bars.High.rolling(p[route]['range_window']).max()
         - bars.Low.rolling(p[route]['range_window']).min())).reindex(dates)
        for route in ('bull', 'bear')}
    momentum20 = (close / close.shift(20) - 1).reindex(dates)
    full_momentum = close / close.shift(p['regime_window']) - 1
    momentum = full_momentum.reindex(dates)
    previous_momentum = full_momentum.shift(1).reindex(dates)
    signal_close, signal_open, previous_close = close.reindex(dates), opening.reindex(dates), close.shift(1).reindex(dates)
    for series in (raw_acf, *positions.values(), momentum20, momentum, previous_momentum,
                   signal_close, signal_open, previous_close):
        assert np.isfinite(series).all(), 'Incomplete causal input history'
    regimes = np.where(momentum >= p['regime_threshold'], 'bull', 'bear')
    previous_regimes = np.where(previous_momentum >= p['regime_threshold'], 'bull', 'bear')
    direction = (signal_close > signal_open).to_numpy()
    expected = pd.DataFrame({'acf1': raw_acf, 'close': signal_close, 'momentum20': momentum20,
        'regime_momentum': momentum, 'regime': regimes,
        'previous_regime_momentum': previous_momentum, 'previous_regime': previous_regimes,
        'bull_range_position': positions['bull'], 'bear_range_position': positions['bear'],
        'confirmation_score': score, 'confirmation_acf': normalized.acf,
        'confirmation_turnover': normalized.turnover, 'confirmation_volume': normalized.volume,
        'bear_acf_raw': raw_acf,
        'entry_signal_close': signal_close, 'entry_signal_open': signal_open,
        'previous_signal_close': previous_close, 'entry_direction_up': direction}, index=dates)
    return _state_path(expected, p)


def _state_path(features, p):
    """Independent state recurrence; features are causal and do not seed state."""
    expected = features.copy()
    assert np.isfinite(expected.acf1.to_numpy()).all(), 'Required original raw ACF must be finite even for recovery'
    for name in ('close', 'momentum20', 'confirmation_score', 'bull_range_position', 'bear_range_position'):
        assert np.isfinite(expected[name].to_numpy()).all(), 'Required finite state feature: ' + name
    assert expected.regime.isin(('bull', 'bear')).all()
    assert expected.previous_regime.isin(('bull', 'bear')).all()
    assert expected.entry_direction_up.dtype == np.dtype(bool)
    c = p['confirmation']
    holding, active, age, anchor, peak, last, last_route, category = False, None, 0, 0., 0., None, None, None
    records = []
    for i in range(len(expected)):
        route = active if holding else str(expected.regime.iloc[i])
        rp, position = p[route], expected[f'{route}_range_position'].iloc[i]
        entry_acf = expected.acf1.iloc[i]
        acf_pass = rp['acf_min'] is None or entry_acf >= rp['acf_min']
        range_pass = bool(position <= rp['entry'])
        momentum_pass = bool(rp['momentum_min'] is None or expected.momentum20.iloc[i] >= rp['momentum_min'])
        recovery = bool(not holding and not acf_pass and range_pass and momentum_pass
                        and expected.regime.iloc[i] == 'bear' and last == 'time'
                        and last_route == 'bear' and category == 'BELOW'
                        and expected.entry_direction_up.iloc[i])
        eligible = bool(range_pass and momentum_pass and (acf_pass or recovery))
        opportunity = bool(not holding and eligible)
        passed = bool(expected.confirmation_score.iloc[i] >= c['threshold'])
        gate = bool(expected.regime.iloc[i] == 'bull' and expected.previous_regime.iloc[i] == 'bear')
        record = {'holding_before': holding, 'route_before': active,
            'age_before': age if holding else 0, 'active_route': route, 'eligible': eligible,
            'range_position': float(position), 'entry_acf_value': float(entry_acf),
            'entry_acf_pass': bool(acf_pass), 'entry_acf_recovery_applies': recovery,
            'entry_eligible': eligible, 'confirmation_opportunity': opportunity,
            'confirmation_pass': passed, 'confirmation_exit_context': last or 'initial',
            'entry_direction_gate_applies': gate, 'last_exit_reason': last, 'last_exit_route': last_route,
            'last_exit_category': category}
        reason = 'flat'
        if holding:
            age += 1
            peak = max(peak, expected.close.iloc[i])
            loss = rp['stop_loss'] is not None and expected.close.iloc[i] / anchor - 1 <= -rp['stop_loss']
            trail = rp['trailing_stop'] is not None and expected.close.iloc[i] / peak - 1 <= -rp['trailing_stop']
            reason = ('loss' if loss else 'trailing' if trail else 'range' if position >= rp['exit']
                else 'time' if age >= rp['max_hold'] else 'regime'
                if p['exit_on_regime_change'] and expected.regime.iloc[i] != active else 'hold')
            if reason != 'hold':
                category = (_exit_category(expected.close.iloc[i], anchor)
                            if reason == 'time' and active == 'bear' else None)
                holding, active, last, last_route = False, None, reason, active
        elif eligible:
            reason = ('entry_direction_rejected' if gate and not expected.entry_direction_up.iloc[i]
                      else 'entry' if passed else 'confirmation_rejected')
            if reason == 'entry':
                holding, active, age = True, str(expected.regime.iloc[i]), 0
                anchor = peak = expected.close.iloc[i]
                last = last_route = category = None
        record.update(signal_reason=reason, target_position=float(holding))
        records.append(record)
    states = pd.DataFrame(records, index=expected.index)
    for name in ('route_before', 'last_exit_reason', 'last_exit_route', 'last_exit_category'):
        states[name] = pd.Series([record[name] for record in records], index=expected.index, dtype=object)
    for name in states:
        expected[name] = states[name]
    return expected


def _validate_parameters(p):
    """Respect original units/domains without casting any numeric parameter."""
    assert set(p) == {'bull', 'bear', 'regime_window', 'regime_threshold',
                      'exit_on_regime_change', 'confirmation', 'context', 'mechanism'}
    assert p['mechanism'] in MECHANISMS
    assert type(p['regime_window']) is int and 5 <= p['regime_window'] <= 60
    assert type(p['regime_threshold']) is float and -.2 <= p['regime_threshold'] <= .2
    assert type(p['exit_on_regime_change']) is bool
    c = p['confirmation']
    assert set(c) == {'enabled', 'profile', 'scope', 'orientation', 'lookback', 'threshold'}
    assert type(c['lookback']) is int and 40 <= c['lookback'] <= 120
    assert type(c['threshold']) is float and -.5 <= c['threshold'] <= .5
    assert c['enabled'] is True and c['profile'] == 'all' and c['scope'] == 'both'
    assert type(c['orientation']) is int and c['orientation'] == 1
    assert p['context'] == {'entry_gate': 'all', 'volume_basis': 'ADJUSTED', 'weighting': 'EQUAL_BLOCKS'}
    for route in ('bull', 'bear'):
        r = p[route]
        assert set(r) == {'range_window', 'entry', 'exit', 'max_hold', 'acf_min',
                          'stop_loss', 'trailing_stop', 'cooldown', 'momentum_min', 'limit_premium'}
        assert type(r['range_window']) is int and 21 <= r['range_window'] <= 360
        assert type(r['entry']) is float and type(r['exit']) is float
        assert 0 <= r['entry'] < r['exit'] <= 1
        assert type(r['max_hold']) is int and 1 <= r['max_hold'] <= 60
        assert type(r['cooldown']) is int and r['cooldown'] == 0
        for key in ('stop_loss', 'trailing_stop'):
            assert r[key] is None or 0 < r[key] < .5
        assert r['acf_min'] is None or (type(r['acf_min']) is float and -.6 <= r['acf_min'] <= .5)
        assert route != 'bear' or type(r['acf_min']) is float, 'Original bear ACF coordinate required'
        for key in ('acf_min', 'momentum_min'):
            assert r[key] is None or np.isfinite(r[key])
        assert 0 <= r['limit_premium'] < .09
    assert p['bull']['limit_premium'] == p['bear']['limit_premium']



def _audit_dates(ctx, bound, binding, frame, dates, bars):
    """Use the bound calendar/execute dates, never a T+1 signal price."""
    dates = dates.as_unit('ns')
    plan = binding.plan
    request = plan.requests[plan.calendar_name]
    calendar = ctx.data.fetch(request, prepared=binding.prepared)
    assert calendar.ready and not SOURCE_CALLS, 'Existing prepared calendar required; no fallback'
    assert calendar.identity.content_sha256 == plan.calendar_sha256, 'Bound calendar identity drift'
    assert canonical_frame_sha256(calendar.dataframe) == calendar.identity.content_sha256, 'Prepared calendar bytes drift'
    assert calendar.identity.dataset == str(request.dataset) and calendar.identity.symbol == request.symbol
    data = calendar.dataframe
    calendar_dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(data.Date)).normalize().as_unit('ns')
    assert calendar_dates.is_unique and calendar_dates.is_monotonic_increasing
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(calendar_dates, pd.date_range(request.start, request.end).as_unit('ns'), check_names=False)
    assert data.IsOpen.isin((0, 1)).all(), 'Invalid public calendar open flag'
    opened = calendar_dates[data.IsOpen.to_numpy() == 1]
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(opened, pd.DatetimeIndex(plan.calendar_dates).as_unit('ns'), check_names=False)
    previous = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(data.loc[data.IsOpen.eq(1), 'PreviousTradingDate'])).normalize().as_unit('ns')
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(previous[1:], opened[:-1], check_names=False)
    assert np.all(previous < opened), 'Public previous-session relation must be strict'
    window = plan.tradable_window
    expected_valid = opened[(opened >= pd.Timestamp(window.start)) & (opened <= pd.Timestamp(window.end))]
    locations = opened.get_indexer(expected_valid)
    assert len(expected_valid) and np.all(locations > 0), 'Complete pre-window signal calendar required'
    expected_signals = opened[locations - 1]
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(dates, expected_signals, check_names=False)
    actual_valid = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(frame.valid_session)).normalize().as_unit('ns')
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual_valid, expected_valid, check_names=False)
    assert dict(plan.signal_dates) == {valid.date(): signal.date()
        for valid, signal in zip(expected_valid, expected_signals, strict=True)}, 'Entire public signal mapping drift'
    # Execution preparation covers first T through final T+1, while the signal
    # OHLC request correctly stops at final T. Only dates below are inspected.
    execution_dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bound.execution_data.execution_daily.dt)).normalize().as_unit('ns')
    assert execution_dates.is_unique and execution_dates.is_monotonic_increasing
    execution_expected = expected_signals.union(expected_valid).sort_values()
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(execution_dates, execution_expected, check_names=False)
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(pd.DatetimeIndex(bound.execution_data.evaluation_sessions).normalize().as_unit('ns'),
                                  expected_valid, check_names=False)
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(bars.index.as_unit('ns').intersection(execution_dates), expected_signals, check_names=False)
    signal_locations = execution_dates.get_indexer(dates)
    assert np.all(signal_locations >= 0) and np.all(signal_locations + 1 < len(execution_dates))
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(execution_dates[signal_locations + 1], actual_valid, check_names=False)
    return {'source': 'Existing prepared bound calendar and execution_daily date sequence',
            'calendar_sha256': plan.calendar_sha256, 'exact_signal_execute_pairs': len(dates),
            'first_signal': dates[0].date().isoformat(), 'last_signal': dates[-1].date().isoformat(),
            'first_valid_session': actual_valid[0].date().isoformat(),
            'last_valid_session': actual_valid[-1].date().isoformat(),
            'final_signal_ohlc_date': bars.index[-1].date().isoformat(),
            'future_signal_prices_used': False, 'final_pair_retained': True}



def _assert_exit_metadata(actual, expected, name):
    """Compare only nullable signal metadata; all financial fields remain exact."""
    categories = {'last_exit_reason': {'time', 'regime', 'range', 'loss', 'trailing'},
                  'last_exit_route': {'bull', 'bear'},
                  'last_exit_category': {'BELOW', 'EQUAL', 'ABOVE'}}
    assert name in categories
    actual, expected = np.asarray(actual, dtype=object), np.asarray(expected, dtype=object)
    assert actual.shape == expected.shape
    missing = np.array([value is None for value in expected])
    for i, (value, wanted) in enumerate(zip(actual, expected, strict=True)):
        if missing[i]:
            assert value is None or isinstance(value, (float, np.floating)) and np.isnan(value), name
        else:
            assert isinstance(wanted, str) and wanted in categories[name], name
            assert isinstance(value, str) and value == wanted, (name, i, value, wanted)
    return int(missing.sum())

    for i in range(len(expected)):

        reason = 'flat'

        record.update(signal_reason=reason, target_position=float(holding))

    states = pd.DataFrame(records, index=expected.index)
    for name in ('route_before', 'last_exit_reason', 'last_exit_route', 'last_exit_category'):
        states[name] = pd.Series([record[name] for record in records], index=expected.index, dtype=object)

def _assert_exit_metadata(actual, expected, name):
    """Compare only nullable signal metadata; all financial fields remain exact."""

                  'last_exit_route': {'bull', 'bear'},
                  'last_exit_category': {'BELOW', 'EQUAL', 'ABOVE'}}
    assert name in categories
    actual, expected = np.asarray(actual, dtype=object), np.asarray(expected, dtype=object)
    assert actual.shape == expected.shape
    missing = np.array([value is None for value in expected])
    for i, (value, wanted) in enumerate(zip(actual, expected, strict=True)):
        if missing[i]:
            assert value is None or isinstance(value, (float, np.floating)) and np.isnan(value), name
